entry.question:
## Physical scenario

A highway curve forms a section of a circle. A car goes around the curve as shown in the helicopter view of figure. Its dashboard compass shows that the car is initially heading due east. After it travels \( d = 840 \text{ m} \), it is heading \( \theta = 35.0^\circ \) south of east.

## Question

Find the radius of curvature of its path.

## Answer choices

- A: A: \[ 2.15 \times 10^{3} \text{ m} \]

- B: B: \[ 0.69 \times 10^{3} \text{ m} \]

- C: C: \[ 1.38 \times 10^{3} \text{ m} \]

- D: D: \[ 1.09 \times 10^{3} \text{ m} \]

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image depicts a curved road segment with two cars traveling along it. The road is shown with dashed yellow lines indicating the center. One car is positioned at the start of the curve, while the other is further along it. A double-headed arrow labeled \(d\) indicates the distance between the two cars along the curve.

Below the road, there is a red compass rose indicating the cardinal directions: North (N), East (E), South (S), and West (W).

A red arrow labeled \(\theta\) is shown to the right, adjacent to the road, indicating an angle with a dashed horizontal line. The arrow suggests a change in direction or orientation related to the road curve.

## Dataset metadata

Kinematics; Spatial Relation Reasoning, Physical Model Grounding Reasoning
